description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/funny route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-funny-directory.json
rules: Every post must make a genuine attempt at humor.
Memes belong in the memes directory; do not post memetic formats here.
Do not repost material that has already appeared in the community.
No personal information, hate speech, harassment, or encouragement of attacks on others.
Keep politics and political figures out of posts.
Do not ask for votes or use low-effort, misleading, or interaction-bait titles.
No gore, pornography, sexually graphic material, or animal cruelty; mark other mature content NSFW.
Do not post text-only images, social-media screenshots, message screenshots, or AI-generated content.
